method_selection_context: Ando labels and historical WIsH results already visible; exploratory retrospective study, not blind validation
purpose: Determine whether independent strain-level scores add a diagnostic signal beyond simple baselines; do not design recognition heads
input_identity: Public references; correspondence to experimental stocks not demonstrated

excluded_constructs.T7_T3_gp17: Exact experimental complete-genome mapping unverified; retain abstention
excluded_constructs.T3_T7_gp17: Exact experimental complete-genome mapping unverified; retain abstention

score_interpretation: Model interaction score, not calibrated infection probability, binding energy or assembly likelihood
training_rules: Do not fit or calibrate on cases.csv, Ando target-publication labels, donor identity or a target/homolog phenotype lookup
Map external phenotype IDs to authenticated accessions/proteomes; record assay meaning and provenance
Audit target stocks, duplicates and near-related phage/host groups by sequences, not filename matching; BL21 already occurs by name in source tables
Exclude target-related groups from supervised training/calibration; define and freeze numerical homology/group rules before training, without optimizing on target labels
Group external validation by publication/construct and phage/host relatedness rather than random interaction rows
Fit feature selection, calibration and hyperparameter choice only within external training partitions; disclose any unsupervised pretraining overlap separately
Freeze retained/excluded IDs, exact dependencies, annotation, clustering, feature selection, model parameters and seeds in a completed run manifest before fitting
Hash trained weights, reference databases and feature mappings before target scoring; neutralize scoring identifiers and keep labels out of inference
unresolved_before_fitting: external training/validation genome and phenotype manifests with hashes
sequence overlap and grouped exclusion report with fixed thresholds
annotation/tool/dependency versions and all train/feature-selection/model parameters
unresolved_after_fitting_before_target_i: reference-cluster, feature-map and trained-model hashes bound to the frozen training specification
inference_controls: Record feature collisions and zero-assignment cases before evaluating target labels; do not retune after target results
Require finite scores for all three candidate hosts per covered phage; missing scores remain abstentions
Actually rerun with neutral filenames/headers and test label permutations only after score freezing
Preserve raw per-model scores, aggregate by the frozen rule and save hashes before evaluation
primary_endpoint: Within-phage positive-negative concordance, ties worth 0.5; macro-average only across queries having both labels
primary_screening_condition: Complete six-case native coverage and concordance strictly above 0.5 and WIsH on the identical subset; otherwise no positive screening signal
comparators: Uniform random top host: expected documented-positive fraction computed per actual candidate set
Historical WIsH restricted to exactly the same evaluated query-host pairs
Always-positive binary baseline on the identical subset, only for a separately declared binary sensitivity analysis
secondary_endpoint: Per-query top-ranked host documented positive, averaging tied winners; do not count unselected hosts as negative

source_label_curation_followup.host_name_correspondence: unique name-based rule corroborated against original source table; not sequence-stock authentication
source_label_curation_followup.host_relatedness_policy: genophi-overlap-policy.json; fixed before first host-similarity run; not yet executed

interpretation_limits: T7 has no negative in this panel; T3 is the only informative native query
Two correlated phages and three hosts do not establish generalization, even with perfect ordering
For T3's three single-positive placements, best possible exact permutation upper-tail fraction is 1/3
Native-only diagnostic success does not pass the existing ten-case complete-coverage gate
No structural binding, gp17 grafting, oligomerization, assembly or functional infection validation inferred
decision: HOLD until mandatory inputs and pre-score run specification are complete; preserve WIsH NO-GO and all source abstentions
